steps.what: Provide training to medical students or staff through demonstration, discussion and corrective feedback

tasks.design: Retain clinical teaching and feedback with the neurologist using existing {DOCS} and {LMS} resources. Reusable materials support instruction without establishing a reduction in demonstration or supervised learning time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Learners need explanations adapted to their clinical reasoning and mistakes.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing educational materials support preparation and reference.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise misunderstanding and provide useful corrective feedback.
tasks.human_edge: Observe learners and connect teaching to actual clinical work.
tasks.altitude: Own the quality of clinical learning.

reach.task: Align supervised teaching with learning objectives

evidence.claim: Clinical instruction retains full time; generic material drafting does not establish savings in this teaching baseline.

assumptions: The baseline is demonstration, discussion and feedback; no large materials-production burden is invented.
Learner questions and observed work arise during s1; there is no automatic competency classification.
Existing resources remain in use without a new automation service or added upkeep.
research_questions: Is a separately measured preparation burden suitable for native reuse features?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Teaching, observation and feedback retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise technicians performing neurological diagnostic and therapeutic work

steps.what: Supervise medical technicians performing neurological diagnostic or therapeutic activities and address concerns

tasks.design: Keep supervision and clinical intervention with the neurologist using {OTHER}, the diagnostic equipment and clinical record system. Status displays can support awareness but do not replace observation, consultation or responsibility for corrective direction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safe supervision depends on the patient, procedure and technician's performance.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing clinical records and equipment displays support oversight.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise when to intervene and how to correct an emerging problem.
tasks.human_edge: Exercise accountable clinical supervision in context.
tasks.altitude: Own the clinical quality of delegated technical work.

reach.task: Clarify escalation and practical supervision needs

evidence.claim: Clinical supervision retains full time; an activity dashboard does not establish reduced supervisory work.

assumptions: OTHER denotes the diagnostic equipment and clinical record system.
Technicians perform the underlying activity; its labour remains outside the neurologist's supervisory baseline and is not claimed as saved.
Observation, questions and intervention remain counted in s1; no free safety flag is assumed.
No new automation service means no added maintenance.
research_questions: Is repetitive status administration measurable outside direct clinical supervision?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Supervision and corrective direction remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define neuroscience research questions, methods and acceptable evidence with the study team
Participate in neuroscience research by investigating evidence and interpreting study findings

tasks.design: Retain research design, investigation and interpretation with the neurologist using {DOCS} and existing {SPREADSHEET} analysis tools. The broad research statement does not establish a repeatable extraction or reporting pipeline.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research contributions vary by scientific question, design and evidence quality.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing research records and analytical tools support participation.
tasks.still_hard: Choose valid methods and distinguish robust findings from artefacts.
tasks.human_edge: Provide clinical insight and challenge scientific assumptions.
tasks.altitude: Own a rigorous clinical contribution to neuroscience research.

evidence.claim: Substantive research participation retains full time; a specific repeatable clerical pipeline is not established by this task.

assumptions: The baseline covers the neurologist's research contribution rather than all study-team labour.
Observation gathering, analytical checks and interpretation remain counted in s2; no prepared structured research dataset is assumed to appear without work.
Existing statistical tools remain in use without new automation or maintenance.
research_questions: Which repeated data preparation steps can be measured separately from scientific design and interpretation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Research design, investigation and interpretation retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prescribe or administer neurological stimulation treatments

steps.what: Prescribe stimulation treatments after assessing indications, patient factors and therapeutic options
outputs: individual stimulation prescription or decision against treatment

steps.what: Administer prescribed treatments and assess patient response during neurological stimulation
inputs: individual stimulation prescription or decision against treatment

tasks.design: Keep stimulation prescription and clinician-delivered treatment with the neurologist using {OTHER}, the stimulation equipment and clinical record system. Existing device control does not establish a reduction in clinical assessment or treatment supervision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Treatment suitability and response depend on the individual patient and stimulation modality.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing clinical records and controlled stimulation equipment support care.
tasks.still_hard: Select appropriate treatment and adapt to patient response.
tasks.human_edge: Take responsibility for clinical suitability and intervention.
tasks.altitude: Own neurological stimulation decisions and delivery.

reach.task: Coordinate stimulation treatment selection and follow-up

evidence.claim: Stimulation treatment selection and clinical delivery retain full time; existing device operation is not new labour saving.

assumptions: OTHER denotes stimulation equipment and the clinical record system.
s2 occurs only when s1 selects treatment; non-treatment decisions remain clinical work.
The baseline is the neurologist's prescribing or delivery work, excluding separate surgical or technician labour.
No new automation service or maintenance is added.
research_questions: Is any repeated treatment documentation measurable separately from clinical selection and delivery?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Clinical selection and treatment delivery remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain clinical training, supervision, research judgement and stimulation treatment responsibility.
role.ambitious_version: A neurologist who uses existing tools while protecting the clinical and scientific work that requires direct professional responsibility.
